newsitem.title: GERMANY: BOXING-HILL OUTPOINTS MASKE TO TAKE IBF AND WBA TITLES.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-HILL OUTPOINTS MASKE TO TAKE IBF AND WBA TITLES.

text.p: American Virgil Hill outpointed Germany's Henry Maske on Saturday to unify the International Boxing Federation and World Boxing Association light-heavyweight titles.
Hill became the first light-heavyweight to hold world titles from two federations simultaneously since Michael Spinks 13 years ago.
"It was a tough fight but we expected that," said Hill, who sustained a slight cut above his left eye. "Henry is a great champion."
Maske apologised to the crowd of 12,500 after his first defeat in 31 professional bouts.
"I'm sorry I've lost in front of you," Maske said. "It was a difficult fight and it was a hard fight."
Spectators in the Munich Olympiahalle booed loudly after the result was first announced as unanimous but then corrected to a split decision a few minutes later.
